applies_to.quote: All Scheduled Commercial Banks Madam / Dear Sir, Guidelines to facilitate faster cross-border inward payments

answer.action: Banks must immediately inform customers of cross-border inward payments, perform frequent nostro reconciliations within an hour, and adhere to updated credit timelines.
answer.action_quote: Accordingly, banks are advised as under: a. Banks shall inform their customer of the receipt of cross -border inward transactions immediately on receipt of inward message.

effective_date.quote: The directions at para 3 above shall be effective six months from the date of this circular.
